note: Private RV and mobile-home park on Hwy 70 east of Portola, under pines; the Middle Fork Feather River is about 200 m away through the forest. Mostly long-stay: 31 mobile-home sites and a seasonal full-hookup class beside the RV sites, and only dry spots are sold by the night online. Heated pool (may close without notice), gym, game room, playground and dog run. --Claude
summary: Feather River RV & MHP: operator site + Firefly engine + Google. flags: PRICE GATE - DROP CANDIDATE: the cheapest RV night the Firefly engine sells is a dry spot at $68.50 (+$3.50 reservation fee, +3.5% processing fee) for 2027-06-15, a Tuesday; no full-hookup site is offered by the night. gateways.py: none within 40 km (Lake Tahoe North 77 km). Not in the Good Sam directory, and the operator posts no member discount. Shoulder-season searches (2027-05-11, 2027-10-05) hit the engine's reCAPTCHA and stayed unread, so a cheaper May/October night can't be ruled out, but the engine showed one price on every unit.
GOOGLE: 3.9 stars from 72 reviews (under 4.0 with 25+ reviews = drop candidate on its own). RV Life stored 5* / $$ (2026-07).

LONG-STAY (reads as mostly seasonal/residential): 31 mobile-home sites + 66 RV sites + 2 cabins; the operator describes 'a residential community ... for those who wish to commute for work' and says 'PLEASE EMAIL FOR SEASONAL RATES!! SPACES ARE VERY LIMITED AND GO VERY FAST!'; the engine's only class is 'Seasonal- Full Hook Up' and it sells ~9-10 dry spots plus group spots by the night. Tests: (1) nightly sold - yes; (2) posted nightly rate - yes, on the engine ($68.50); (3) no standing minimum outside holidays (3 nights on holidays); (4) nightly share ~10 of 66 RV sites (~15%, ~10% of all 97 spaces) - inside the 10-50% caveat band at best; (5) no lots for sale seen. With the price and Google rating this is a drop candidate on several counts.
